snippet.title: THE RANGERS IN THE SOUTH - Full Gameplay Walkthrough Part 1 [FULL GAME] No Commentary
snippet.description:
The Rangers In The South Full Gameplay Walkthrough on PC in No Commentary, which will include full game playthrough guide, all cutscenes, all dialogues, all boss fights, final boss & ending, Enjoy!

This is a fully edited gameplay walkthrough/playthrough of The Rangers In The South Game, Full Game is played, recorded & edited by myself. 

Game Description
The Rangers in the South is a PIXELART ACTION ROGUELIKE RPG set in a beautiful 2.5D world inspired by the SNES classics. Fight and design a unique strategy with hundreds of alternatives to explore different biomes and challenges

Purge the lands in this 2.5D HD Pixelart RogueLike ARPG! Create hundreds of characters with unique strategies and abilities, face hordes of enemies, explore different biomes, procedurally generated dungeons, and obtain unique items!
